_comment: Refunds a duplicated DAG transfer at ordinal 731650.
The DAG leg of the PROT-1695 recovery, 7,676.52080818, was funded twice by two different
wallets within 47 minutes of each other:
updated-pools-14.json books the DAG leg exactly once, so the wallet ends 7,676.52080818 above
the book. Refunding one of the two restores reserve == wallet. The book is not touched, so no
pool price moves and no LP position changes.
The destination is the sender of the first transfer. Which of the two is refunded is a
business decision, not an arithmetic one: both are the same amount, so either restores 1:1.
The custody address has no private key, so this cannot be done as an ordinary transfer.
A SpendAction is the only mechanism.
currencyId is deliberately absent: this is DAG, which has no currency id.
Between 731648 and this ordinal the DAG ledger reads 7,676.52080818 over-backed and
CollateralInvariant will report it. That direction is harmless - it can never create a
shortfall - and it clears when this settles.
IRREVERSIBLE. The destination cannot be recovered if it is wrong.
